skill:rally.text:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent fantasy tactical-RPG UI skill icon, production source to downsample to 128px then display at 32–40px.
Reference images are style references only, never screenshot contents to copy: Image 1 is the approved ivory/copper action-icon family; Images 2–3 are approved dark game HUDs showing context.
Primary request: extend this exact simple, flat, warm-ivory icon family with ONE new skill icon for RALLY (self-healing/regroup, restores health). Depict a single simple upright heart silhouette cradled from below by one upward-curving recovery arrow. Large legible heart, broad recovery arrow, at most one clean inner contour. This is healing, not attack.
Style: match the reference icons' pale warm ivory/light gold solid fill, restrained thin copper-brown contour, smooth clean contours, minimal detail, no bevels, no realistic shading, no gradients, no glossy effects. Visual weight and contrast identical to the boot/sword/hourglass reference.
Composition: exactly one centered icon alone on genuinely transparent canvas, isolated object with ample transparent margin. Square composition. One icon only, no sheet, no variations.
Avoid: no words, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no UI panel/backplate, no border/frame, no scene, no characters, no glow haze, no dark opaque silhouette, no checkerboard baked into pixels. Preserve genuine alpha transparency.

Subject: A broad straight physical arrow flying diagonally toward upper-right, clearly recognizable triangular arrowhead, solid shaft and two large fletching feathers at lower-left. Two short parallel motion streaks behind it communicate strong ranged shot. No bow, no target circle, no lightning, no sparkle.
